key_insight: QESChunker unifies overlapping and non-overlapping RAG chunking as supervised, budget-aware optimization of question–evidence utility.
engineering_relevance: It builds document-specific static chunk indices from annotated or LLM-generated question–evidence pairs without access to held-out test queries.
method: Optimize a unified question–evidence utility objective to select chunks.
Without overlap, exploit chunk-wise decomposition for exact polynomial-time dynamic programming.
With overlap, use monotone submodularity for a greedy (1−1/√e)-approximation to the NP-hard problem.
evidence_signal: Across two self-constructed and three public datasets, both variants improve complete-evidence recall over existing chunkers in nearly all evaluated settings with matched overlap regimes and a fixed hybrid retriever.
watch_item: Deployment requires document-specific question–evidence supervision; its creation cost and quality should be assessed.
paper_title: QESChunker: A Single Objective Unifies Overlapping and Non-Overlapping Chunking for RAG
